MemberList.description: MemberList is the member list of a static segment.

maxEntries.description: MaxEntries is the most cached answers.

ttl.description: TTL is how long an answer is cached, a duration such as "30s".

SegmentCache.description: SegmentCache sizes the cache of a lookup segment.

name.description: Name is the name that rules use: segment("name").

connection.description: Connection names a connection of the relay bootstrap file: a dynamic segment.

members.description: Members are the members of a static segment. An empty list is a static segment with no member.

key.description: Key is the key of the set (layout set) or the prefix of the member keys (layout keys) in the store.

layout.description: Layout is "set" (default) or "keys". The keys layout is lookup only.

missingKey.description: MissingKey is "notMember" (default) or "unknown": what a segment that does not exist in the store means.

onError.description: OnError is what a lookup that could not be answered becomes: "notMember" (default), "unknown" or "member".

version.description: Version says how the version of the segment is learned (dynamic only).

cache.description: Cache sizes the cache of a lookup segment.

value.description: Value is a version that the document carries.

key.description: Key is the version key in the store.

interval.description: Interval is the poll period of Key, a duration such as "5s" (needs Key).

SegmentVersion.description: SegmentVersion is the version of a dynamic segment: the publisher bumps Value, or the writer of the members bumps the version key Key in the store, which the relay polls every Interval.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the document version, "semaphore/v1". Empty means the current version when marshalling.

kind.description: Kind is "Segments". Empty means "Segments" when marshalling.

SegmentsDocument.description: SegmentsDocument is the document of kind Segments: named segment definitions.
